problem.question: Charley has a bag that contains 51 white beads and 90 black beads. He reaches in the bag and pulls out 1/6 of the black beads and a third of the white beads. How many beads in total did Charley pull out?
problem.answer:
Charley pulled out 90/6 = <<90/6=15>>15 black beads.
Charley pulled out 51/3 = <<51/3=17>>17 white beads.
Charley pulled out 15+17 = <<15+17=32>>32 beads in total.
#### 32
